pointers.sentence: `STATICFILES_FINDERS` names the finders; `django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py` holds their base class `BaseFinder`, the two the setting names by default, `FileSystemFinder` and `AppDirectoriesFinder`, the storage finders, and `find`, which asks them in turn.
`BaseFinder` declares three methods and implements none (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:BaseFinder`).

Django's finders list with `get_files`, which walks a storage and skips a file whose name or relative path matches a pattern, and a directory whose name does; `matches_patterns` tests with `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`, case-sensitive everywhere (`django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:get_files`, `django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:matches_patterns`).

Django's finders list with `get_files`, which walks a storage and skips a file whose name or relative path matches a pattern, and a directory whose name does; `matches_patterns` tests with `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`, case-sensitive everywhere (`django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:get_files`, `django/contrib/staticfiles/utils.py:matches_patterns`).

An entry is a directory, or a pair of a prefix and a directory; the finder keeps each pair once, in order, and makes a `FileSystemStorage` for each directory, setting on it an attribute `"prefix"`, which collectstatic puts before each of the directory's paths (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:FileSystemFinder.__init__`).

With a prefix, the path must begin with the prefix and the platform's separator, `os.sep`, which are taken off; the rest is joined to the directory with `safe_join`, and the result returned if it exists, a directory included (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:FileSystemFinder.find_location`).

When made, it goes through the application configs in the order of `INSTALLED_APPS`, makes a storage of its `AppDirectoriesFinder.storage_class`, `FileSystemStorage`, for each one's directory, and keeps those that exist, under the application's name (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:AppDirectoriesFinder.__init__`).

`AppDirectoriesFinder.find` asks each storage in turn with `FileSystemStorage.exists` and answers with `FileSystemStorage.path`, which is `safe_join` again (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:AppDirectoriesFinder.find_in_app`).

`BaseStorageFinder` finds files in a storage, given to it or set as its class attribute `BaseStorageFinder.storage`, and raises `ImproperlyConfigured` with none; it finds nothing in a storage with no paths on disk, where `Storage.path` raises `NotImplementedError` (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:BaseStorageFinder`).

`DefaultStorageFinder` is one over `default_storage`, the `"default"` storage of `STORAGES`, and refuses one whose `base_location` is empty, as a `FileSystemStorage`'s is with no location and `MEDIA_ROOT` left empty; one with no `base_location` passes (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:DefaultStorageFinder.__init__`).
The default `STATICFILES_FINDERS` has it commented out (`django/conf/global_settings.py`).
The module's `find` empties `searched_locations` and asks each finder in the order of `STATICFILES_FINDERS` (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:find`).
`find` no longer takes all, deprecated in 5.2 for find_all (`docs/releases/6.1.txt`).
`get_finder` is wrapped in `functools.cache`, so each finder is made once in a process and keeps the directories it found then (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:get_finder`).

Under `override_settings`, receivers of `setting_changed` clear the cache when `STATICFILES_DIRS`, `STATIC_ROOT` or `INSTALLED_APPS` changes (`django/test/signals.py:static_finders_changed`, `django/test/signals.py:update_installed_apps`).

Under `override_settings`, receivers of `setting_changed` clear the cache when `STATICFILES_DIRS`, `STATIC_ROOT` or `INSTALLED_APPS` changes (`django/test/signals.py:static_finders_changed`, `django/test/signals.py:update_installed_apps`).
`StaticFilesConfig.ready` registers two checks under the tag `Tags.staticfiles` (`django/contrib/staticfiles/apps.py:StaticFilesConfig.ready`).

`check_storages` returns `"staticfiles.E005"` when `STORAGES` has no `"staticfiles"` storage; `check_finders` calls each finder's `check`, and of Django's finders only `FileSystemFinder` has one (`django/contrib/staticfiles/checks.py:check_finders`).

`FileSystemFinder.check` returns `"staticfiles.E001"` alone when `STATICFILES_DIRS` is not a list or tuple; otherwise, for each entry, `"staticfiles.E003"` for a prefix that ends with a slash, `"staticfiles.E002"` for a directory that is `STATIC_ROOT`, and the warning `"staticfiles.W004"` for a directory that does not exist (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:FileSystemFinder.check`).
A path found nowhere is reported on standard error, except at verbosity 0, and the command still succeeds (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/findstatic.py:Command.handle_label`).
